svg.title: The 95% intervals of Claude Code and Codex CLI overlap, so these runs do not establish a difference in pass rate
svg.desc: The 95% intervals of Claude Code and Codex CLI overlap, so these runs do not establish a difference in pass rate. Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5): pass rate 100% [89, 100], pass^3 100%, flip rate 0%, median cost $0.0886; Codex CLI (gpt-6-luna): pass rate 93% [79, 98], pass^3 80%, flip rate 13%, median cost n/a. Measured with rerun-bench: uvx rerun-bench, github.com/Abelo9996/rerun-bench.
